limits: Post-promotion/pre-eviction input and post-eviction output, before visibility compaction. Prepared victim decisions are fixed inputs; this corpus does not independently validate selection/promotion. F32 stored as exact raw bytes including nonfinite values. No KV contents or hardware-performance claim. No cold overflow observed; saturated/nonfinite/tie/invalid-input and promotion-selection fixtures remain required. Replay preserves raw F32 bytes, CPU metadata, slot/free ordering and queued compaction indices. It is not a new controller, speed or quality claim.
